title: TITLE_NOT_USED
paragraphs: This latest framework rewrite has been fun so far. I'm moving away from Django and into Flask for the backend. I'm also staying away from Django's Jinja templates. I've decided to give Svelet a try instead. So far, it's coming along smoothly.

This content is driven from a JSON object in /static/<page>.json. Eventually it'll get loaded from a database perhaps. I want to have a default set of content though for others so it works out of the box. Another great benifit of having this as JSON text is I dont have to rebuild the site to change the content. Similar to how it would be if it was pulled from the database but much easier to edit for people that don't have a database handy to throw content into. Also, you can use LAMBDA functions or something to edit the content. It all runs inside a docker container.
